properties.name: powerjob.worker.register.admin-api-max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum attempts for each PowerJob admin API call. Values greater than 1 enable retry with linear backoff.

properties.name: powerjob.worker.register.admin-api-backoff-millis
properties.description: Base retry backoff in milliseconds for PowerJob admin API calls. The effective wait is base backoff multiplied by the attempt number.

properties.name: powerjob.worker.register.admin-api-circuit-failure-threshold
properties.description: Number of failed PowerJob admin API operations that opens the circuit breaker.

properties.name: powerjob.worker.register.admin-api-circuit-open-duration-millis
properties.description: How long the PowerJob admin API circuit breaker stays open before allowing a half-open probe.
